'''Terminal 24''' was an entrance from an [[Underworld portal/Legends|underworld portal]] into [[Level 1313/Legends|Level 1313]].

==History==
After capturing [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] brought her to terminal 24, and Tano convinced Ventress to help her. The pair was spotted by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was coming to land at terminal 24 with a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on two [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunships]]. Anakin jumped off his gunship and onto the landing platform, but Ventress activated the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] between the terminal and the rest of [[Level 1313/Legends|Level 1313]], enabling herself and Tano to escape.
